slides.title:
Two tenants.
One Microsoft 365.
slides.description: Merge, split, or carve out Microsoft 365 tenants against a real TSA-exit date. Mail flow, free/busy sharing, and directory sync are live for Day-1 coexistence.

slides.title:
Off Google Workspace.
Off the old Exchange.
slides.description: Google Workspace, on-premises Exchange, or another tenant into Microsoft 365. Mailboxes, files, PST archives, and Teams content move with delta syncs.

slides.title:
Built around how
your business runs
slides.description: Sales, Customer Service, and Business Central configured to your quoting, service, and fulfillment steps, not the out-of-box setup.

slides.title:
Power Apps everywhere.
No shadow IT anywhere.
slides.description: Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio built with the environment strategy, ALM, and DLP policies around them.

slides.title:
When legal asks,
you have an answer.
slides.description: Microsoft Purview configured properly: retention labels, sensitivity labels, legal hold, and eDiscovery your counsel can rely on.

slides.title:
Legacy apps.
Modern on Azure.
slides.description: Lift-and-shift, containerize, or re-architect on Azure, whichever the application actually needs. Then CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and monitoring.

slides.title:
Search that finds
the right file
slides.description: Teams isn’t usually the problem — information architecture is. We fix channel sprawl, ownership, and permissions so people stop re-creating what already exists.

slides.title:
Contracts stop living
in someone’s inbox.
slides.description: Email handoffs replaced by a Power Automate workflow and a SharePoint or Dynamics 365 repository. Status, approvals, and renewal dates stop being a question.
